Ray Brown

Independent candidate for Governor, Tennessee · Open seat

Electrician, Y-12 National Security Complex

Edgar "Ray" Brown is an electrician from Oliver Springs, Anderson County, who is running for governor of Tennessee as an independent. He filed on January 14, 2026, and qualified for the November 3, 2026 general election ballot by petition. He has not held elected office before.

Where Brown stands

Government ethics / Corruption
Says he is running to stand up against corruption in Tennessee's legislative and judicial systems (statement from his Facebook page, quoted in an independent voter guide).

Background

  • Electrician, Y-12 National Security Complex (2018–present)
  • Intelligence Specialist, Delta 21 (2011–2026)
  • Software Tech, Sitel (2010–2011)
  • Assistant Store Manager, K-Va-T (2008–2010)
  • A.S., Roane State Community College (2005)
  • Associate's degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Pellissippi State Community College (2023)
  • No prior elected office
